plain_description: **Use DeepSeek-V3 to generate text, answer questions, and help with code and math.** Run it locally or use DeepSeek’s chat website and OpenAI-compatible API. It supports deployment on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs.
technical_description: DeepSeek-V3 is a 671B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model with 37B parameters activated per token. The README describes local inference through DeepSeek-Infer Demo, SGLang, LMDeploy, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, with FP8 and BF16 options across supported hardware. It also offers a chat website and an OpenAI-compatible API. The repository metadata identifies safetensors as the model format and lists a minimum RAM estimate of 1369 GB and recommended RAM of 2053.5 GB.
title: DeepSeek-V3
